Name: Caleb Stonewall

Name: Casey Moth

Name: Christian Ball
Description: Started fortune-telling for a laugh, but many now believe he has real powers.

Description: Though he was once a popular child actor, most don't recognize him now.

Description: Dreams of becoming a pilot and flying solo across the Pacific Ocean.

Description: His mask scares everyone around, but he only wears it out of shyness.

Description: His family owns a great area of land, where he holds paintballing events.

Name: Pontius Blank
Description: A fearless warrior, always on the front line in his paintballing team.

Name: Gwen Slinga
Description: Always carries a pair of toy revolvers, which she can fast-draw and spin.

Description: Wears a mask to hide his face, but they say he's a looker.

Description: An appreciator of panel art, he finds simple designs especially appealing.

Description: Promised to skip tutoring if he wins, he attacks every match in the Shopping District tournament with zeal.

Name: Mira Fiendish
Description: Gentle on the outside, she strikes like a demon and fights so hard she tears up as her hands ache in pain.

Name: Carly Veneer
Description: Laid-back and easygoing, he's the racket expert everyone trusts while cruising through the game.

Name: Ponny Grace
Description: Gifted and graceful, her love for the game shines through every artistic return she makes.

Name: Aria Fondue
Description: Nervous alone, she plays doubles and somehow always ends up chasing hotpot restaurants in busy spots.

Name: Charlet Namora
Description: More into chatting about table tennis than playing, she's now hooked on hunting hot springs.

Name: Lorenzo Dellart
Description: A rebel with wild ideas who's caused plenty of property damage chasing the meaning of beauty.

Name: Aimee Porteret
Description: Draws portraits that glam up models so much they look new, winning fans by making everyone cuter.

Name: Mireille Modelle
Description: Swamped with modeling requests, she holds every pose for hours without breaking a sweat.

Name: Greef Lonbrusch
Description: Having very few friends, he pours his loneliness into art that drips with sorrow.

Name: Bracker Grippe
Description: So strong he snaps paintbrushes like twigs and is always broke buying new ones.

Name: Trew Talif
Description: Spots flaws smaller than sand grains and chases perfect photorealism.

Name: Madeline Milke
Description: Needs a cup of hot milk before drawing or nothing happens.

Name: Giovanni Buston
Description: Dreams of creating world-shaking art and is currently sculpting a statue of someone stirring a pot.

Name: Audreen Slumberey
Description: Draws from dreamscapes and makes sure to get plenty of sleep for fresh ideas.

Name: Zinnia Crylic
Description: Steals school flowers for her art and spends half her time dodging angry gardeners.

Name: Alara Belmont
Description: A proud rich girl on the outside, but secretly she craves a true friend she can really trust.

Name: Lyla Loveland
Description: This tennis ace wins more hearts off the court with her stunning androgynous charm than on it.

Name: Ana Santini
Description: Her warm, nurturing smile puts people at ease, and she always steps up to help those who rely on her.

Name: Dasher Ballard
Description: A tennis prodigy born to race across the court with lightning speed that leaves opponents breathless.

Name: Javor Bonnaire
Description: Born into wealth, he backs his future with relentless work, turning confidence into unstoppable drive.

Name: Tobin Tempelhof
Description: A politician's son dreaming big but held back by the fear of social media's harsh spotlight.

Name: Shiryu Hanabusa
Description: Raised in a family of folk dance masters, every move he makes is pure elegance crafted to perfection.

Name: Dyne Amic
Description: Athletic and unstoppable on the pitch, yet somehow just as spectacular at flunking exams.

Name: Callista Norton
Description: She rules the court with a bright smile so genuine you can't help but forgive her every win.

Name: Neve Paisley
Description: Trained by a pro mom, her racket work is razor sharp and built for fierce competition.

Name: Serene Goldwell
Description: New money by one generation, she polishes every move to look every bit the refined elite.

Name: Mirko Harding
Description: No matter the game, his uncanny knack for tracking the ball makes him look like a natural star.

Name: Clyde Dalen
Description: He works like a tireless machine, giving 100% every time and earning respect from students and teachers alike.

Name: Curia Caldwell
Description: Drawn to the strange and unusual, she can't help but poke her nose where it doesn't belong.

Name: Ava Ehrenreich
Description: Plays the cute mascot, but behind her smile is a bold strategist already scouting her future husband.

Name: Cassiel Longstaff
Description: To calm the track and field club drama, he's scheming to rename it the "Pole Vault Club" and shake things up.

Name: Farran Corsa
Description: His weird running style throws off rivals because he's convinced brains beat legs in long-distance races.

Name: Geri Spears
Description: A skilled javelin thrower whose smooth throws always fly straight and beautiful, earning cheers every time.

Name: Lita Vault
Description: Hurdles are just another dance step as she flies through like gravity forgot to show up.

Name: Leero Pard
Description: Running with leopard-like grace and fierce power, he hunts every tenth of a second like a wild beast.

Name: Russ Radcliff
Description: Cool and collected under pressure, he nails everything except the one thing—passing the baton.

Name: Batton Farrow
Description: Forgetful in life but laser-focused on the baton, he never lets it slip during the race.

Name: Jett Allegri
Description: He explodes off the line with raw power and feeds off the crowd's roar to push even harder.

Name: Ralya Chersey
Description: She's a lively tomboy who created the rhythmic jump, charging up with a run and her idol's chant.

Name: Wing Hyland
Description: With a poker face like a queen, she battles only herself and stays unshaken no matter how low the bar falls.

Name: Thalia Petras
Description: Once shy and bookish, she fell for ancient Greek art and now focuses on shot put with fierce passion.

Name: Calina Breezer
Description: Always half-asleep and laid-back, she surprises everyone by powering through marathons when there's a prize.

Name: Lace Tangler
Description: Clumsy but charmingly airheaded, her biggest problem is shoelaces that won't stay tied, making her trip nonstop.

Name: Eli Hoopsen
Description: He's a relentless fireball sweating it out till the final whistle, all while dreaming of winning hearts someday.

Name: Marcel Leapman
Description: Athletic and carefree, he's less about winning and more about pulling off slick dribbles that steal the show.

Name: Tris Baylor
Description: Convinced that nailing big shots wins hearts, he drills three-pointers nonstop chasing his moment to shine.

Name: Dunk Highfield
Description: Obsessed with slam dunks, he dreams big and trains hard in his mind, still chasing that perfect jump in real life.

Name: Somnal Brightmore
Description: He pores over a basketball star almanac every day, dreaming of the day he's the one in print.

Name: Pillan Hallstead
Description: Holds up a basketball team of rookies with steady hands and a smile, no matter how bad the pass.

Name: Leander Courtman
Description: Declares himself the basketball team ace with flair to spare, even though he rarely gets subbed in.

Name: Laurence Stumbleton
Description: So focused on the crowd's reaction, he ends up missing the ball and tripping over his feet.

Name: Figgo Balpark
Description: Tries to sound like a data pro but blurts out made-up numbers that don't make sense to anyone.

Name: Lazaro Coveton
Description: Quietly envies the spotlight, but waits to be noticed just for being himself.

Name: Nicolas Pirrant
Description: Loves basketball to death... and totally misread the rankings when signing up to South Cirrus.

Name: Hazlo Prophyle
Description: Tried to be the team's shadow hero and avoid the spotlight, but mostly ended up invisible.

Name: Emil Tait
Description: Copies pro athletes' bedtime routines for his glow-up plan, hoping it'll help him stand out.

Name: Fouad Togenick
Description: Posts daily practice clips and pics, tweaking every angle to look just right.

Name: Talken Bigby
Description: A shameless show-off who lies to impress, then panics when his promises fall apart.

Name: Jasper Chatterly
Description: Club chairman who leaks juicy idol gossip to the newspaper club. Secrets are his sweet spot.

Name: Foster Bracewell
Description: Lives by "Devotion is true love" and gave all for his idol's upcoming graduation concert.

Name: Dreamer Havenridge
Description: Feeling down, he met his current idol and has supported her ever since so she can shine.

Name: Smiles Thrussell
Description: "An idol's smile can save the world" is his motto as he fires up the crowd to lift his favorite's mood.

Name: Noelle Harmon
Description: Sharp hearing means she catches cheers but ignores haters— they're just background noise.

Name: Grace Starlet
Description: Now a ninth grader, she lacks confidence in singing and dancing but works hard to keep smiling.

Name: Eden Snowbell
Description: A cosmetics expert who pushes her favorites on friends and dreams of starring in commercials.

Name: Octavia Carroll
Description: Her vibrant high-pitched voice is praised, and she often helps out as soprano in the choir club.

Name: Valentine Lovejoy
Description: A rising idol known for flawless charm at handshake events— everyone who meets her falls hard.

Name: Hope Astor
Description: Always watching for fans at school, she charms them with a cute wink when she spots one.

Name: Dina Kingston
Description: Known among the female students for her princely image, she secretly wants to wear cute outfits too.

Name: Levy Vales
Description: A fan of old-school solo idols, he's searching for a kindred spirit to help debut.

Name: Flash Lighton
Description: Throws all his energy into making concerts exciting and has a must-see glow-stick routine.

Name: Banner Weaving
Description: Not just a merch collector, he plans to craft goods for his favorite idol too.

Name: Finley Brooks
Description: Focused purely on speed, he leads swimmers quietly, unlike the flashy water polo crowd.

Name: Alonzo Readdie
Description: The team's number two changes clothes fast— anything to beat the water polo club by a second.

Name: Galina Chilvers
Description: Tinted goggles make the perfect cover for sneaky naps after early practice.

Name: Rockin Sunshaide
Description: He dreams of designer sunglasses but is fine with his goggles until he can save up.

Name: Medwin Silvers
Description: Despite winning only silver medals since childhood, he still feels he's not quite good enough.

Name: Kipper Marino
Description: A mysterious boy who swims like he never needs to breathe. Some say he was a fish in a past life.

Name: Wale Gambon
Description: He hasn't learned proper technique yet, but his powerful flutter kick makes him fast enough to win.

Name: Calem Backstrom
Description: Rough in personality but surprisingly smooth, his silent backstroke barely stirs the water.

Name: Castor Fatica
Description: Once hopeless, he worked hard to float and soon started standing out.

Name: Papilla Revert
Description: An injury forced her to switch styles, but now she dominates butterfly like no one else.

Name: Amita Rudd
Description: Her easygoing breaststroke lets her swim endlessly, and not even the summer camp coach can keep up.

Name: Yarden Forsman
Description: With a killer dolphin kick, he pulls ahead fast. His challenge: lasting long enough to stay ahead.

Name: Cheery Allende
Description: Prone to leg cramps, she takes breaks, but her cheers still reach the far edge of the pool.

Name: Rafton Calmers
Description: He plays rough but never fouls, always yelling, "The mermaids must love me!"

Name: Ballmer Netting
Description: Laid back but a top scorer. If anyone blocks him, he'll throw them into the goal, too.

Name: Avan Floane
Description: He loves the floaty feeling lying in bed after games and fights hard to keep his starting spot.

Name: Davey Lockers
Description: He plays rough to break opponents' spirits and is known as the "Devil of South Cirrus."

Name: Akela Portner
Description: Quick reflexes and height make him a natural goalie, though he's nervous alone but steady in a team.

Name: Divar Deepwell
Description: Confident in his lungs, he dives underwater to grab opponents carrying the ball.

Name: Cleon Balogh
Description: He tends to pitch only with his left arm but has an extraordinary range of motion to catch the ball.

Name: Credence Throwe
Description: He swears the opponent's fouls create the best chances and times his throw-ins perfectly.

Name: Ivo Woodward
Description: Never losing balance in rough water, he shuts down one attacker after another with pure core strength.

Name: Gentino Sorella
Description: His little sister wants to play, so he's pushing the advisor to start a girls' team.

Name: Richter Poole
Description: Worried teammates might get hurt from rough play, he chose to become a referee who never lets it slide.

Name: Lior Morrissey
Description: He switched from swimming to water polo club for the wild style, but teammates suspect he's a spy.

Name: Focas Quayle
Description: Lately, he's been craving the pure focus of swimming but can't bring himself to leave water polo club.

Name: Timmit Bower
Description: Trying to overcome his shyness by acting tough, he still apologizes every time he bumps someone.

Name: Izekiel Truth
Description: A science geek with more knowledge than anyone at school, he dismisses the occult and trusts only facts.

Name: Gemma Coombs
Description: Having met her grandmother's ghost, she's ready to try anything to see her again.

Name: Fuyo Catcher
Description: He built a drone to track UFOs, but it moves so fast even he can't control it.

Name: Eviden Tracer
Description: He tackles every problem like a case, always saying, "Science never lies!" as he digs into analysis.

Name: Murray Hollowpot
Description: Son of a famous local pub where ghosts come for the food and strange tapping noises never stop.

Name: Morrigan Shutterly
Description: Her hobby is studying ghost photos, always hunting for proof and hoping to snap one herself.

Name: Sylas Saxton
Description: A genius who never studies, he spends all his time cracking codes instead of hitting the books.

Name: Ferdy Fenwick
Description: Once obsessed with the occult, he now lives for science— but hasn't told his clubmates yet.

Name: Hazel Woodrow
Description: Once, she missed her stop and ended up at a creepy station, but she walked all the way home by sheer will.

Name: Ouijane Boarden
Description: She made an AI Ouija divination board game, but her friends are too scared to try it.

Name: Flaurine Woodwind
Description: A passionate Reyes fan who sees other supporters as rivals and is picky about selecting ensemble members.

Name: Kellan Beatley
Description: A skilled percussionist who loves rare instruments and has become a bit of a collector.

Name: Louise Basson
Description: A strict but reliable bass section leader who trains hard to win first place in contests.

Name: Claudette Clackenoff
Description: An attention seeker who loves castanets and dreams of performing a solo performance someday.

Name: Brooke Reedman
Description: He broke a club veteran's clarinet but is too scared to admit it or ask for repairs.

Name: Cornelia Hoopett
Description: A quaint girl who loves round things and became a horn player because of its looping tubes.

Name: Penelope Mozartin
Description: A classical music fan who knows all about the great composers, and wishes she lived in their time.

Name: Brianna Summing
Description: A modest girl who wants the spotlight once and plans to cheer on the baseball club on local news.

Name: Henrietta Kettingham
Description: Stickler for etiquette who'll fix your bow angle and your instrument's position before you can say "tuning."

Name: Marjorie Piperplume
Description: A bird lover who picked up the flute just to play duets with her feathered friends.

Name: Dizzy Fumbleton
Description: She's clumsy but always saves her instrument first because bruises heal faster than repair bills.

Name: Donovan Brasswagon
Description: His trombone's loud, but his dance moves are louder— clear a path when he starts to play.

Name: Liselotte Heartsway
Description: She joined for love, not music, hoping a certain baseball club boy would notice her from the brass section.

Name: Jaslyn Warbleton
Description: She's a jazz natural with riffs so smooth even the teacher forgets to critique.

Name: Francesca Fintootle
Description: She dreams of blasting cheers on her trumpet but secretly doubts her lungs can keep up.

Name: Ezekiel Gravendirge
Description: Learned to exorcise spirits with nothing but a hum and now clears bad vibes just by singing to himself.

Name: Regis Tunesmith
Description: A future conductor already in command, he swaps pens for a baton in every class.

Name: Vincent Melodin
Description: Lets out a gorgeous melody when spooked, which only makes him a bigger target for prank-lovers.

Name: Renee Sirensong
Description: Her first cry made the obstetrician weep, and she's been silencing rooms with her voice ever since.

Name: Monica Kinbird
Description: She nails any classmate's voice perfectly and switches styles so fast you can't tell which one's hers.

Name: Sonata Cherub
Description: Claims to be an angel, and honestly, her voice is enough to make you believe it.

Name: Allegra Langton
Description: Her notes go on forever thanks to breath control that even athletes envy.

Name: Millicent Vociere
Description: A warm-hearted newcomer who sings any part she's given and nails it every time.

Name: Selena Sopralis
Description: A crystal-clear soprano whose voice is so pure it sometimes disappears into thin air.

Name: Rondo Harmond
Description: Handles every instrument the choir club needs and somehow plays them all like he was born for it.

Name: Aretha Rumbell
Description: Her voice rumbles low and deep with a rich vibrato that shakes you to your bones.

Name: Hexine Cantation
Description: They say she sings a cursed carol that leaves you dazed, dreamy, and begging for more.

Name: Rockson Grohl
Description: Lives for music and worships rock, but can't shake the feeling most join the club just to look cool.

Name: Sadley Lonsom
Description: Falls hard and fast but luck's never on his side, leaving heartbreaks and sad guitar tunes in his wake.

Name: Blossom Laine
Description: Raised on visual kei, she turns heads and fires up the crowd with legendary headbanging moves.

Name: Thompson Hummings
Description: Started as a rookie craving attention but earned his spot through nonstop grind and steady charm.

Name: Trebor Donders
Description: He turned restless legs into thunderous drums with a double bass speed that floors the crowd.

Name: Liron Suesskind
Description: Keeps his voice sharp by sneaking candy all through class— no teacher ever catches him.

Name: Marius Harlow
Description: Obsessed with carrying his instrument every day he built crazy stamina even as an indoors kid.

Name: Raya Sixstring
Description: A lone wolf chasing singer-songwriter dreams whose street performances stop people in their tracks.

Name: Minna Smallwood
Description: Quirky collector who matches her favorite bandmate's gear and dreams of jamming side by side.

Name: Cleara Sounds
Description: Hardcore earphone nerd with an encyclopedic ear for sound who won't touch wireless buds for anything.

Name: Hop Sadler
Description: Bassist with a pedal obsession who never plug them in but loves staring at his colorful collection.

Name: Bang Revell
Description: Can't play a note but owns the stage with his killer air guitar moves that steal the spotlight every time.

Name: Verica Nyman
Description: Obsessed with gossip, she spins wild tales to keep the rumor mill buzzing just the way she likes it.

Name: Aldus Ogden
Description: Kicked out of the newspaper club by Nyman, he's stuck mourning the shift from print to endless SNS posts.

Name: Veronica Camry
Description: A camera whiz who's the idol-lovers club's go-to for flawless on-site shots that capture every perfect moment.

Name: Cora Inkton
Description: Writes a beloved corner column in the school paper where her warm stories brighten readers' days.

Name: Uriah Goldfield
Description: Relentless in chasing mischief, he digs up dirt and spreads the wildest stories right alongside Nyman.

Name: Adal Miramond
Description: Aims to outdo the occult society by digging up and sharing the creepiest mysteries available.

Name: Trace Combe
Description: Proofreads the manga club's four-panel comics with care while quietly dreaming of launching his own series.

Name: Tito De Core
Description: Masters flashy headlines that grab attention but sometimes stray so far they spark a storm of complaints.

Name: Fiona Leroux
Description: Instead of bashing school romances, she's all about backing them and shaking up old-school attitudes.

Name: Nance Meridian
Description: She knows sensational sells but sticks to her ideals, never trading integrity for clicks or headlines.

Name: Memo Rize
Description: Has a photographic memory and catches every word in interviews with perfect recall, no recorder needed!

Name: Krome Tallic
Description: Obsessed with metal—rocks, not riffs—and somehow recruits lost metalheads into the mineral club instead.

Name: Jewelyn Plunkett
Description: Admires jewels but thinks they're kinda cheesy, so she hides her nerves behind fierce punk rocker makeup.

Name: Gildred Gainstead
Description: Drawn to gold for its steady value, he pours every New Year's allowance into his shiny stash.

Name: Ezrail Corbell
Description: A die-hard rail fan disguised as a rocker who surprises everyone with his polite, down-to-earth nature.

Name: Culinaro Brons
Description: Collects cooking tools like a pro but can't cook a fried egg to save his life—irony served hot.

Name: Elian Kitronic
Description: The electronics store's top guy so valued they wish they could clone him for every shift and customer.

Name: Slater Verbenbaum
Description: Aims to craft music that leaves a mark, not tears. Just that unforgettable feeling that stays long after.

Name: Kurtz Armishaw
Description: Hooked on weapons and their pull but always short on cash to build the collection he dreams of having.

Name: Tessa Rapperton
Description: A chatterbox turned rapper who keeps her disses gentle since trash talk isn't her style.

Name: Miriam Masheene
Description: Obsessed with anything mechanical that moves, especially the exposed guts of industrial machines.

Name: Armani Armure
Description: Loved armor so much he tried wearing it to class but gave up after his parents put their foot down.

Name: Gusmin Strelbard
Description: Got a unique, beautiful voice that no one else can match, all thanks to grandma's shigin lessons.

Name: Jayce Chorden
Description: Blasts his guitar loud to blow off steam because it's about shaking the whole room, not headphones.

Name: Tobias Thumpern
Description: Switched from taiko to drums chasing a dream but finds the thin sticks oddly unsatisfying to hold.

Name: Kara Okenridge
Description: Loves singing for crowds and often drowns out others with her loud karaoke harmonies.

Name: Kohara Staley
Description: Dreams of catching the Kraken and spends every day tracking sightings and witness reports.

Name: Kye Sendon
Description: Loves fish so much he studies and eats them— spot a bowl of seafood and he's already lining up.

Name: Jella Fisker
Description: Drifts like a jellyfish, she's quiet and easygoing until she drops a venomous remark that stings hard.

Name: Salpida Longwheel
Description: From a family of twins and triplets, her family gatherings always overflow with doppelgangers.

Name: Ezra Bachmann
Description: Always carrying fresh food, he's ready for any surprise meeting with unknown sea creatures.

Name: Evon Newground
Description: Believes krakens are ocean-floor humans and is determined to find a way to talk with them.

Name: Barrac Kuda
Description: A free-diving sea hunter whose lightning-fast swimming snags anything that crosses his path.

Name: Mako Carcher
Description: A lover of sharks and low-budget shark flicks who surprises many with her passion and enthusiasm.

Name: Inga Calmari
Description: An eccentric researcher exploring squid ink's secrets who lately experimenting with ink painting.

Name: Azure Marcet
Description: Fascinated by the ocean floor but uneasy around deep-sea fish. He visits exhibitions to adjust.

Name: Octavian Da Lua
Description: Can't resist tight dark spaces and once got stuck in the club room needing a rescue.

Name: Megal O'Donn
Description: Once a dinosaur fanatic, now hooked on sharks and imagines epic battles to crown the strongest.

Name: Tempest Liebkind
Description: Usually gentle and soothing, her anger is so fierce it can reduce the whole club to tears.

Name: Griffin Fastwell
Description: Lost an esports match to a delayed click and swore never again; now he trains his body as seriously as his APM.

Name: Sienna Fairborn
Description: Dominates the ranked ladder on stream with skills so sharp even adults get quiet when she plays.

Name: Lockin Somnal
Description: Even asleep he's grinding aim trainers to perfect his signature move: the clean 180 headshot.

Name: Aeron Rushmore
Description: Racing games got him hooked on speed, so now he bikes everywhere just to chase that feeling in real life.

Name: Grayson Tiltwood
Description: He swears he's a puzzle god, but every time he loses, it's gravity's fault, not his.

Name: Calix Virtus
Description: Maxed out his stats in real life and moved on to the virtual world, aiming to perfect the brain too.

Name: Torwyn Endeavor
Description: Wants a rival to train with, someone who'll push him until they both face the whole world together.

Name: Torric Brawnstone
Description: Bulking up to look scary in the lobby, he crushes high-calorie meals like they're power-ups.

Name: Cassia Bladecroft
Description: Known across FPS circles as "Slash'n Cut," a gamer tag that makes even veterans flinch.

Name: Actie Verran
Description: She trains like a pro and wants her chance, but every time she grabs the controller, they tell her to wait.

Name: Ellie Fumble
Description: Trains daily just to keep up with her little brothers, but can't walk straight without bumping into a wall.

Name: Biijiro Onoda
Description: His newspaper follows one guy's wild dream to go from average to unstoppable student council president.

Name: Kujira Torikawa
Description: Every special move he dreams up hits big in his manga, and he hopes Dora-meown Ball gets published.

Name: Romain Romanze
Description: He reads more shōjo manga than anyone and dishes out romance advice that always lands perfectly.

Name: Edton Prentt
Description: The club's ruthless editor who bends over backwards to crush deadlines no matter what it takes.

Name: Drewey Fournell
Description: Sticks to four-panel manga because going beyond that just burns him out fast.

Name: Edith Endenwald
Description: Convinced every great manga ends with an explosion, she rewrites others' endings just to stir the pot.

Name: Harolde Narcissus
Description: A total narcissist, he draws manga just to share his own flawless beauty with the world.

Name: Manon Matopia
Description: Reads manga aloud with perfect voice acting for every onomatopoeia like it's the main show.

Name: Soria Bordeau
Description: Called the Empress of Storyboards, she wins hearts with dialogue that hits deep despite her subpar art.

Name: Norah Noshawn
Description: Shows up twice a year like a ghost, but drops thoughtful manga feedback before vanishing again.

Name: Puffet Vearn
Description: Joined the council just to be near Lilac— one kind word from her and he's all in.

Name: Glorian Flaunt
Description: Loves bragging about test scores, then walks you through the answers with a glowing smile.

Name: Rhianna Wardholdt
Description: Keeps a sharp eye out for rule-breakers and runs the school committee like a well-oiled machine.

Name: Ordin Scriben
Description: Polite on the surface, but underneath? He wrote 1,710 pages of rules and you better follow every one.

Name: Coraline Quisittor
Description: Looks quiet and mild, but when she glares, even the teachers straighten up.

Name: Judis Nitcher
Description: Seems like he'd be popular, but his habit of snitching to teachers has everyone steering clear.

Name: Lawton Dappermann
Description: Spends two hours getting ready every morning and dreams of turning the whole planet into model students.

Name: Rudgar Dennings
Description: Doesn't look it, but he's a total softie who spends his afternoons quietly tending the flowerbeds.

Name: Hardan Kempton
Description: Obsessed with beautification and always handing out flyers, yet forgets to tame his own wild hair.

Name: Montgomery Marchand
Description: A kind cheerleading captain who always backs the underdog— even switching sides mid-game.

Name: Elmer Trommel
Description: Runs the squad like a human metronome, keeping every chant sharp and perfectly in sync.

Name: Cane Fangley
Description: Stands with Wulfgang to defy the elites, though part of him secretly admires those he's rebelling against.

Name: Fenric Wulfgang
Description: Leads the Wolves & Dogs with a fierce grudge against the elites and no interest in making peace.

Name: Romica Glimmerly
Description: Top dog of the Chipper Girl "Queens," she plays her role perfectly to gather intel on snagging a rich future.

Name: Stran Linemont
Description: As soon as the bell rings, he's out the door like a rocket— no one clears the school grounds faster.

Name: Lacie Pawford
Description: Says she's an indoors girl, but her dog drags her into a nightly showdown over walk time.

Name: Marcol Leapstone
Description: With monkey-like reflexes and endless stamina, he turns the trip to school into a full-blown parkour run.

Name: Ignacio Gerhardt
Description: A walking ball of justice who can't stand wrongdoers, he idolizes Ferrell and keeps his fire burning bright.

Name: Rynor Rushenfort
Description: Stubbornly upbeat no matter what, he's powered through every obstacle with pure force of will.

Name: Crag Bolderin
Description: Gave up mountain climbing and picked a flatland school, but treats the stairs like his personal summit.

Name: Bowie Buffoon
Description: Lives to make people laugh, and when words fail him, he lets his goofy moves do the talking.

Name: Margot Napier
Description: Sleeps through most classes yet somehow tops the grades —rumor has it she studies in her dreams.

Name: Colette Brushmont
Description: Art nerd aiming for the top, and once she starts talking about painting, there's no stopping her.

Name: Blue Cleverley
Description: Loves both Go and shogi but feels stuck in the middle of the two clubs' awkward rivalry.

Name: Matilde Pendlebury
Description: Her friends always count on her, but she finds it tough to ask for help herself.

Name: Niro Vannaburg
Description: So obsessed with Krakburgers he can sniff one and tell which shop it came from.

Name: Heather Lovella
Description: A new recruit with a thing for romance gossip whose memorized every love-themed poetry card in the set.

Name: Brannon Chalant
Description: Drifts through school on autopilot, slowly growing anxious about how aimless life feels.

Name: Jayden Durance
Description: Struggles with breathing technique, but with a kickboard and stamina to spare, he just keeps going.

Name: Capricia Saiz
Description: Calm and consistent as a setter, she's gained quiet fans thanks to her flawless tosses and rare soft smile.

Name: Colm Dawdlin
Description: Hard at work on a new programming language he hopes to finish before graduation.

Name: Adelaide Plainhart
Description: She wanted a quiet junior high life, but her elegant tea ceremony skills keep her in the spotlight.

Name: Sami Wampovich
Description: Turned down the marine biology club to study river life solo in total peace and quiet.

Name: Alphonse Wreckenbach
Description: Top student by grades, but at the table he's the "King of Destruction," always smashing the ball by accident.

Name: Annie Glenvale
Description: A bold dancer with talent to spare—once the music hits, her body just moves.

Name: Fitzbon Vivant
